entities.title: ZAZZLE_SOCK
entities.scope: Read by `zazzled serve` (unless --socket is given or launchd passed a socket), by `zazzled mcp` to reach the daemon, and by `zazzled install`, which writes it into the LaunchAgent. The C invoker reads it too (macos/c/zazzle/src/zazzle_core.h build_path).
entities.details: A daemon installed as a LaunchAgent keeps the path that was current when `zazzled install` ran.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_SESSION
entities.summary: The session key for ids, dedupe and rerunning a response with read-again on the command line.
entities.default: unset (no session: no session ids, no dedupe and no rerun by read-again; stored clean, run and proxy outputs still carry their own ids and can be read again)
entities.scope: Read by the C invoker, which sends it in the request (macos/c/zazzle/src/zazzle_core.h build_request), and by `zazzled run`. The daemon itself does not read it; `zazzled mcp` uses a random session per process instead.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_IDLE_SECS
entities.summary: How long `zazzled serve` waits with no connection before it exits.
entities.scope: `zazzled serve`, including a daemon the invoker or the MCP front end starts, which inherits their environment. `--idle SECS` overrides it.
entities.validation: A value that is not a whole number is ignored and the default used.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_CACHE_DIR
entities.scope: `zazzled serve`. `zazzled run` uses no persistent cache.
entities.validation: If the directory cannot be created or opened, the daemon prints `zazzled: cache disabled: ...` and runs with the in-memory cache only. A new directory is made mode 0700, marked for Spotlight not to index, and on macOS excluded from Time Machine.

entities.title: HOME
entities.summary: The base of the default socket path, cache directory, output store and indexer state directory.
entities.scope: Every zazzled subcommand that needs a default path, `zazzled install` for ~/Library/LaunchAgents, and the C# indexer bridge.
entities.validation: Unset: `HOME is not set` where a default path is needed; the cache is then disabled, outputs are not stored (unless ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR is set) and carry no output id, and C# files are read as source.

entities.title: zazzled serve --socket, --idle
entities.summary: Command-line options of `zazzled serve`: an explicit socket path, and the idle time in seconds.
entities.scope: One `zazzled serve` process. The tests and the invoker's smoke test and benchmarks start the daemon with --socket.
entities.validation: A missing value, a non-numeric --idle or an unknown option is a usage error, exit 2.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_INDEXER
entities.summary: The zazzle-csharp-indexer executable the daemon uses for the terse C# view and the structure tools.
entities.default: zazzle-csharp-indexer beside the zazzled executable, else the first on PATH
entities.scope: Read in the process that renders a C# read (the daemon, or `zazzled run`), on each such read.
entities.validation: An empty value counts as unset. If no executable is found, C# files are read as source with `(no terse view: zazzle-csharp-indexer is not installed (beside zazzled or on PATH); this is the source)`. Its version is asked once per executable and process.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_INDEXER_STATE_DIR
entities.summary: The indexer's state directory, which holds its daemon socket; zazzled looks for `daemon.sock` there.
entities.key: ZAZZLE_INDEXER_STATE_DIR (falling back to XDG_STATE_HOME on Linux)
entities.scope: The C# indexer bridge, on each C# read and each structure command. It mirrors how the indexer itself chooses the directory, so both must see the same environment; a daemon zazzled starts inherits zazzled's.

relationships.description: The indexer owns the state directory's layout.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_DIR
entities.summary: Where clean, run and proxy outputs are stored for read-again.
entities.scope: Read by each process that stores or loads outputs: `zazzled serve` and `zazzled run` when they open their engine (clean stores, read-again loads), `zazzled wrap` on each run, and `zazzled proxy` at its start. A `zazzle run` or proxy output can be read again only by a daemon that uses the same directory.
entities.validation: An empty value counts as unset. Without it and without HOME nothing is stored. The directory is created mode 0700 and each file 0600; a save that fails leaves the output in the answer with a note that it was not stored.
entities.details: A daemon keeps the directory it started with; `zazzled wrap` reads the variable from the caller's environment on every run.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_OUTPUTS_MAX_GB
entities.summary: The output store's size limit in gigabytes.
entities.scope: Read by the process that stores an output, on each save: the daemon for clean, `zazzled wrap` for run, `zazzled proxy` for shortened texts.
entities.validation: A value that is not a number, or not above 0, is ignored and the default used. After a save, if the entries younger than an hour hold more bytes than the limit, the oldest go until half remain.

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LANGUAGES_DIR
entities.summary: Where language modules and the JIT setting are kept.
entities.scope: Read by zazzled when it loads, lists or fetches language modules.
entities.details: The `jit` file in it holds `on` or `off` (`zazzle languages jit`).

entities.title: ZAZZLE_LANGUAGES_URL
entities.scope: Read by zazzled when it downloads a module.
entities.details: Downloads are still checked against the manifest compiled into zazzled, so another source can only serve the same files.

entities.title: ZAZZLED_LANGUAGES_MANIFEST (build time)
entities.summary: The language module manifest compiled into zazzled.
entities.default: unset: an empty manifest (development builds have only the built-in grammars)
entities.details: The release sets it to the manifest language-modules.sh --manifest wrote after building and signing the modules.
